headline: Root-fixed a recurring cascade-drift class and surfaced a 23-day production incident.

items.title: Cascade-drift class root-fixed + structural gate added
items.insight: Four [skip ci] publisher crons were committing a base feed while stranding their byte-checked derived artifacts, making build:check red on every clean pull and public trust surfaces serve stale values between crons. Fixed all four live instances (uptime-probe, refresh-live-data, vault-narrative, build-ship-receipts generatedAt churn) and built a structural gate check-publish-cascade-coverage.mjs (self-test 14/14, live 27/27) wired into build:check so the class cannot silently return.
items.evidence: scripts/check-publish-cascade-coverage.mjs — self-test 14/14, live 27/27; npm run build:check EXIT 0 (220/220, +2 gate steps)

items.title: 23-day production incident diagnosed and surfaced (founder-gated)
items.insight: The security Worker was clobbered out-of-band on 2026-07-03 with a build missing /v/rum; RUM telemetry ingest has been dark since 2026-07-02. Live Worker 405s /v/rum vs the repo's 204. The honest 47.6% uptime is the S275 forcing-function — not massaged. Redeploy is founder-gated behind the fail-closed production promotion hold (Supabase/identity); surfaced with evidence and exact restore command rather than overridden (CANON-019).
items.evidence: api/uptime-data.json — 47.6% uptime; redeploy: gh workflow run cloudflare-worker-deploy.yml -f confirm_production=true

items.title: Ark cargo shipped: sitemap false-negative in studio-ops check
items.insight: check-sitemap-compliance.mjs false-negatives static <page>/index.html legal/contact/ip pages (all present and deployed), dragging portfolio Compliance signal to 86%. Shipped a repo-question cargo to studio-ops (id 01JUDDNSAID43C1B5B481F0B03) without editing the sibling tree.
